settings.ceo_bio:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
DADO — bu shunchaki keramogranit emas, bu sifat, dizayn va ishonch uyg‘unligidir. Biz har bir mahsulotga uzoq muddatli qiymat yaratish nuqtayi nazaridan yondashamiz.

Maqsadimiz — mijozlarimizga nafaqat chiroyli, balki ishonchli va zamonaviy yechimlarni taqdim etish. Biz DADO brendini sifat va mas’uliyat bilan rivojlantirishda davom etamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
DADO — это не просто керамогранит, а сочетание качества, дизайна и доверия. Мы подходим к каждому продукту с пониманием его долгосрочной ценности.

Наша цель — предлагать клиентам не только красивые, но и надёжные современные решения. Мы продолжаем развивать DADO, сохраняя высокие требования к качеству и ответственности.
settings.ceo_bio_en:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.

news.excerpt: DADO launches a partnership programme for interior designers and architects: a sample library, project consultations and the option to meet clients in the showroom.

news.excerpt: The new ITALICA collection is devoted to large format: 600×1200 and 800×1600 slabs with concrete and terrazzo looks. We explain why large format is the designers' choice today.

history.title: DADO is founded
history.text: DADO is founded in Tashkent. Its first focus is supplying the construction market with quality imported ceramics. The principle of long-term client relationships takes shape in these early years.

history.title: The first showroom
history.text: The company's first showroom opens in Tashkent. Clients can now see tile in an interior context and handle samples in person. This step turns DADO from a supplier into an advising partner.

history.title: Own brands: CROWN, ITALICA, TORRA
history.text: DADO launches its own brands. CROWN embodies classic marble and stone, ITALICA modern minimalism, and TORRA bold design and decorative surfaces. Every collection is produced and inspected to the company's specifications.

history.title: A service for projects
history.text: A dedicated service for architects and designers was launched: technical advice, sample work and delivery planning brought together in one place. Working with large projects became faster and more precise.

history.title: 20 years and a new showroom concept
history.text: DADO marks its twentieth year. The new showroom concept presents all three brands in dedicated zones with real interior scenes. The company continues to develop delivery to every region of Uzbekistan and its partner network.

values.title: Who we are
values.text: DADO is a modern porcelain stoneware company that brings together quality, design and trust. We offer solutions for different styles and needs, continuously developing our range and supplying products to the Uzbekistan and international markets.

values.title: Our goal
values.text: Our goal is to offer high-quality, modern and reliable porcelain stoneware solutions, make the choice easier for our customers and develop DADO as a brand people can trust.

values.title: Our mission
values.text: Our mission is to combine quality, modern design and technology to help create beautiful, functional and long-lasting spaces. We strive to be a reliable partner for every customer and help find solutions that match their needs and style.
